# WayfinderGEO

> AI search visibility agency. We run Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI optimization (AIO) and technical SEO as one system, and we report on citation share inside AI answers rather than keyword rankings.

WayfinderGEO helps brands get named, quoted and linked inside the answers generated by ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and Microsoft Copilot.

- Website: https://wayfindergeo.com/
- Contact: hello@wayfindergeo.com
- Founded to serve: founders and marketing teams competing for the recommendation slot in their category
- Engagement model: flat monthly retainer, ninety day initial term, month to month after that

## What we do

- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: prompt research and share of voice tracking, citation gap analysis against named competitors, answer ready content built for passage retrieval, entity and knowledge graph reinforcement, off site presence on the sources models trust.
- **AI optimization (AIO)**: structured data and schema architecture, llms.txt and crawler access configuration, agent log auditing, semantic content chunking and heading structure, rendering speed and core web vitals, freshness signals.
- **Foundational SEO**: technical audits and crawl health, topical authority and internal linking, content strategy mapped to buyer intent, local and multi location visibility, digital PR and authority link acquisition.

## Pricing

- **Beacon, 500 USD per month**: full AI visibility audit and baseline score, tracking on up to 50 priority prompts, core schema and structured data build, llms.txt and crawler access setup, two answer ready pages optimized per month, monthly visibility report and one strategy call, email support within one business day.
- **North Star, 1500 USD per month**: everything in Beacon, plus tracking on up to 300 prompts across every major model, competitor share of voice and citation gap analysis, six answer ready pages produced or rebuilt per month, off site placement and digital PR for citation sources, entity and knowledge graph reinforcement, agent log monitoring and technical SEO retainer, live dashboard with biweekly calls and a shared Slack channel.

Multi location, ecommerce catalogue and enterprise scopes are quoted separately. No setup fee, no percentage of ad spend.

## How the engagement runs

1. **Baseline**: audit of where the brand stands across every AI surface, benchmarked against three named competitors.
2. **Diagnose**: prompt mapping, citation gaps, entity coverage and technical blockers, separating content problems from authority problems.
3. **Build**: schema, site structure, answer ready pages, entity reinforcement and placement on sources models already trust.
4. **Compound**: track, prune and expand. AI visibility behaves like interest rather than a campaign.

## Frequently asked

**What is GEO and how is it different from SEO?**
SEO earns a position in a list of links. GEO earns a mention inside a generated answer. The inputs overlap because models still lean on indexed content, but the targets differ: GEO optimizes for passage level retrievability, entity clarity, third party corroboration and quotability.

**Can an agency influence what ChatGPT says about a brand?**
Influence yes, control no. Models draw on indexed pages, live retrieval and the wider corpus of what the internet says about a brand. Work covers all three.

**How long before visibility moves?**
Technical fixes register within weeks and crawler activity is usually visible in month one. Meaningful citation share generally moves between month two and month four.

**How is performance reported?**
A live dashboard covering visibility score, share of voice against named competitors, prompt level wins and losses, citation sources and AI crawler activity, plus a written monthly analysis.

## Key context on the market

- Roughly 68 percent of Google searches now end without a click to any website.
- Organic click through rate drops around 60 percent on average when an AI Overview is present.
- AI referred visitors convert at roughly four times the rate of traditional organic traffic, on conservative industry estimates.
- About 70 percent of consumers now use generative AI tools for product and service recommendations.

These are blended industry averages from publicly reported 2026 research, not WayfinderGEO client results.
